item.title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js)
item.description:
Приєднуйся до Zeely AI як Senior Backend Developer та розвивай backend одного з найбільших AI-продуктів для бізнесів у США.

 

Zeely — AI Marketing Platform із 2M+ користувачів, яка допомагає бізнесам створювати AI-креативи та UGC-відео, запускати кампанії в Meta/TikTok і масштабувати маркетинг в одному продукті.

 

Наша backend-команда вже налічує 10+ інженерів і продовжує рости. Шукаємо сильного backend-first інженера, який працював із highload-системами, впливав на архітектуру та брав ownership за production-рішення.

 

З чим працюватимеш:

  • backend-сервіси та REST API;
  • PostgreSQL, Redis і data flows;
  • мікросервісна архітектура;
  • AWS, Docker, message brokers;
  • зовнішні API та платіжні інтеграції;
  • performance, reliability, debugging і code review;

  • інтеграції з AI API та розвиток AI-функціональності продукту.

     

Що для нас важливо:

  • 6+ років комерційного досвіду з Node.js;
  • актуальний production-досвід із NestJS;
  • сильний практичний досвід із PostgreSQL;
  • мікросервіси та highload;
  • Redis, AWS, Docker;
  • message brokers і платіжні системи;
  • досвід проєктування масштабованих і надійних систем;

  • впевнене розуміння production ownership.

     

Буде плюсом:

  • AI APIs;
  • Terraform / Pulumi;
  • AWS certification;
  • backend для mobile + web;

  • Upper-Intermediate English+.

     

Формат: remote-first, офіси у Варшаві та Києві.

 

Процес:
Intro Call → Test Task → Technical Interview → Final Interview → Reference Check → Offer

 

Надсилай резюме — будемо раді познайомитися 💚

item.title: Senior Node.js Backend Developer
item.description:
Hi! We are looking for a Senior Node.js Backend Developer (Payments Platform) to join our pack at SharksCode 🦈💙
 SharksCode is a Ukrainian IT company that develops high-tech software solutions and scalable B2B platforms.
 We are looking for a Senior Node.js Backend Developer who will help build and evolve our payment platform, working on scalable backend services, distributed systems, and integrations with external financial providers. In this role, you will participate in architectural decisions, develop secure and reliable payment flows, and contribute to building resilient, high-load backend services.

We expect that you:

  • Have 6+ years of commercial backend development experience with Node.js.
  • Have strong commercial experience with TypeScript and a deep understanding of its type system.
  • Have hands-on experience designing and developing REST APIs.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.
  • Have experience decomposing complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Can clearly explain and justify technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and alternative approaches.
  • Have strong practical experience with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, schema design, and performance tuning under high load.
  • Have hands-on experience designing and developing microservice-based distributed systems.
  • Understand distributed and event-driven architectures.
  • Have practical experience working with Kafka.
  • Have hands-on experience using Redis.
  • Have experience implementing retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and backpressure mechanisms.
  • Have experience integrating third-party APIs, including payment providers, PSPs, banks, KYC providers, or other external services.
  • Have a solid understanding of secure software development principles.
  • Have practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, JWT, HMAC, mTLS, API authentication, and authorization.
  • Can identify security vulnerabilities in code, APIs, dependencies, configurations, and system architecture.
  • Have experience conducting code reviews and technical audits of backend services.
  • Understand principles of protecting personal, payment, and other sensitive data.
  • Have a strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, DNS, Webhooks, and the lifecycle of network requests.
  • Understand TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle management, rotation, and secure certificate storage.
     

Your future responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services for the payment platform.
  • Build reliable integrations with payment providers, banks, and external financial services.
  • Develop scalable microservices and distributed backend components.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Optimize PostgreSQL performance and ensure system reliability under high load.
  • Ensure backend security and compliance with engineering best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards within the team.
  • Collaborate closely with product, QA, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable production solutions.
     

Nice to have:

  • Experience with GraphQL or gRPC.
  • Experience building payment platforms, financial services, or payment processing systems.
  • Experience in iGaming, Betting, FinTech, Banking, or E-commerce domains.
  • Understanding of payment lifecycle concepts such as authorization, capture, void, refund, reversal, and chargeback.
  • Understanding of reconciliation, settlement, payment routing, and cascading.
  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, KYC/AML, and secure payment data processing.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, or Jaeger.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices.
  • Understanding of threat modeling, attack surface analysis, secrets management, and the principle of least privilege.
     

Interview stages:
🤝 Interview with Recruiter.
🧠 Technical Interview.
💙 Offer.

We offer:
🌴 24 paid vacation days, 14 sick days, and 5 days off.
⏰ Flexible start of the working day — from 9:00 to 11:00.
🏥 Medical insurance.
💰 Bonuses and performance-based rewards.
🐶 Office in the center of Kyiv — pets are welcome, we are pet-friendly.
💆 Lounge area in the office to recharge during the day.
🎾 Padel tennis, football, and training at the polygon for those who enjoy active leisure.
📚 Learning compensation, internal meetups and workshops, as well as access to the corporate LMS with courses.
🎁 Corporate currency that can be exchanged for merch, gifts, or additional benefits.

item.title: Backend Team Lead (Node.js)
item.description:
About the Role

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role where you will combine strong backend engineering expertise with technical leadership and people development.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers, owning execution across multiple workstreams and helping shape technical decisions from initial design through production.

We’re looking for someone who is technically strong, hands-on, AI-driven, and passionate about developing people while building scalable and reliable systems.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on software development experience
  • 3–5 years of experience in a technical leadership or Team Lead role
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Node.js — must-have
  • Strong experience with AWS — must-have
  • Experience with React — preferred
  • Experience with Python — advantage
  • Experience working with MongoDB
  • Strong experience designing and building scalable backend systems
  • Proven experience managing technical execution across multiple workstreams
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, reliability, and clean code principles
  • Experience delivering end-to-end features and projects from design through production
  • Experience working in a fast-paced product environment
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to make technical decisions independently
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience leading or collaborating with global or distributed teams
  • Ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience participating in customer-facing technical discussions

 

What You’ll Be Doing

Leadership & Sprint Execution

  • Own Team Execution: Lead the team across multiple workstreams, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong execution throughout every sprint.
  • Drive Sprint Planning: Own the sprint planning process, including prioritization, capacity planning, and alignment on sprint goals and deliverables.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Act as the primary bridge between your team and other departments, proactively removing blockers and managing cross-team dependencies.

  • Develop the Team: Improve team velocity and individual capabilities through ongoing coaching, mentoring, feedback, and identification of skill gaps.

     

Technical Excellence & Design

  • Own Technical Design: Lead the technical design of features and solutions, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and built according to strong engineering standards.
  • Stay Hands-On: Lead by example through active participation in high-scale, cloud-based development using technologies such as Node.js, AWS, and MongoDB.
  • Drive Code Quality: Conduct thorough code reviews and promote best practices around architecture, maintainability, performance, and engineering quality.
  • Partner with Product: Work closely with Product Managers to shape features from initial concept and technical design through development, release, and production.

item.title: Senior Backend Engineer
item.description:
Superagent AI is building the AI-native distribution layer for insurance - a $7T industry still run on manual workflows and legacy software. We're an early-stage, fast-moving team reimagining how insurance is sold, serviced, and supported, with AI at the core. Backed by top-tier VCs, we're an international team of exited founders, builders, and technologists.

 

Already trusted by 100+ agencies, the job now is to build the next version of the platform quickly and run it reliably as we continue to scale rapidly — a real-time voice platform, an agent/skills layer, omnichannel messaging, and deep insurance system integrations.

 

Why this role exists

The product is in production and growing, and the hardest problems now live in the backend. We're bringing on at least two senior backend engineers to take real ownership across our core systems: real-time voice at growing call volume, a Temporal-driven campaign engine, multi-tenant data with strict isolation, and LLM/agent orchestration that has to be reliable.

 

There's a lot still to build. We're expanding deep into insurance-system and AMS/CRM integrations, and building on frontier AI technologies that most teams don't have access to yet — you'll get your hands on capabilities well before they're widely available. Each of you will own meaningful surface area end-to-end — designing it, building it, shipping it, and keeping it running.

 

This is a hands-on builder role. You take ambiguous, high-impact problems and turn them into shipped, reliable software. You're trusted to make architecture calls in your area, raise the quality bar, and set an example for how we build as the team scales.

 

What you'll own

  • Shipping backend features end-to-end — from design through production, in one of our pods (Voice/AI, Campaigns + Integrations, or Platform/Reliability).
  • Architecture of the systems you touch — event-driven flows, workflow orchestration (Temporal), data models, and the APIs other teams build on.
  • Building what's next — new insurance-system and AMS/CRM integrations, plus greenfield work on frontier AI technologies we get early access to before the rest of the market.
  • Reliability of what you ship — on-call for your services, SLOs, test automation, and turning flaky things "boring." Reliability is our #1 lever.
  • Velocity through AI-native engineering — you use Claude Code and Codex every day to orchestrate coding agents and raise your leverage, without letting speed erode the reliability bar.
  • Raising the bar around you — thoughtful code review, pragmatic technical decisions, and mentoring less-experienced engineers.

 

About you (must-haves)

  • 6+ years building production backend software, still hands-on and shipping.
  • Strong in TypeScript / Node and comfortable in a NestJS-style monorepo.
  • Distributed / event-driven systems — you have specific opinions on queues, backpressure, idempotency, retries, and how services should communicate.
  • PostgreSQL depth — schema design, query performance, and an understanding of multi-tenant isolation.
  • AWS and production ownership — you've operated what you've built: monitoring, incidents, debugging real issues under load.
  • You live in Claude Code / Codex (or equivalent) — fluent and opinionated about AI-assisted engineering. In 2026 we treat this as table stakes.

  • Ownership mindset — you own your work end-to-end, including in production, and you're close to how it affects real agencies.

     

Bonus

  • Real-time voice / telephony (Twilio, SIP, ASR/TTS, latency-sensitive audio).
  • Building agentic systems - tools/skills frameworks, MCP, evals, guardrails - in production.
  • Applied LLM work: fine-tuning, distillation, eval-driven development.
  • Insurance, fintech, or another regulated/compliance-heavy vertical.

 

Our stack & tools

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node, NestJS · monorepo (libs + apps)
  • Orchestration: Temporal (Temporal Cloud) for the campaign/workflow engine
  • Data: PostgreSQL on AWS RDS (multi-tenant, row-level security)
  • AI: Anthropic + OpenAI models, prompt/agent orchestration, evals; fine-tuned/distilled models on our own data
  • Frontend: React / Next.js
  • Platform: AWS · Clerk (auth) · Datadog (observability) · Pylon + HubSpot (CS/CRM)
  • How we ship: Linear (with agent delegation), GitHub, and Claude Code + Codex as part of daily engineering

 

How we build (engineering principles)

  • Reliability is a feature. We don't ship what we can't keep running. The quality bar is non-negotiable.
  • AI-native by default. Claude Code, Codex, and coding agents are part of how we work, not a novelty. We expect leverage from them, every day.
  • Close to the customer. We prioritize real agency calls and feedback, not opinions in a room.
  • Ship small, ship often. Short cycles, fast feedback, evals over guesswork.
  • Ownership. Engineers own their work end-to-end - including in production.

 

How we work

Fast-moving distributed team with an AI-native engineering culture. We're closer to our customers than most competitors - that's our edge, and it drives how we prioritize. We ship things that work for real agencies, not demos.

item.title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js + Java)
item.description:
Blackthorn Vision is seeking a Senior Backend Developer (Node.js + Java) for an outstaff project with a global leader in energy technology. Founded in 1926 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, the company has 100,000 employees serving customers in more than 120 countries and develops software solutions for automation across the energy and industrial sectors.

 

You will work as part of an international team, collaborating with Blackthorn Vision specialists, client-side engineers, and management. We are looking for a self-driven team player with strong problem-solving skills, a commitment to quality, and a passion for delivering robust and maintainable software solutions. Upper-Intermediate English or higher is required for effective day-to-day communication. The position follows a regular full-time working schedule aligned with the Ukrainian time zone.

 

In this role, you will build and support backend services that process operational and time-series data and deliver reliable APIs and event-driven solutions. You will work with technologies such as Kafka, Azure IoT Hub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Kubernetes, and Microsoft Azure to develop high-performance, resilient, and scalable applications.

 

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, and REST APIs.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture and business requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka and RabbitMQ.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Redis, or similar relational/NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, and Azure IoT Hub.
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and modern observability tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, or similar.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

     

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with operational and time-series data.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

     

We Offer:

  • Exciting and challenging work in a friendly and professional environment.
  • Excellent career opportunities and competitive salary.
  • Flexible work schedule.
  • Professional development program with internal seminars on technical topics.
  • Courses, certifications, and access to the corporate library.
  • Free English classes.
  • 18 working days of paid vacation, 5 full-paid sick leave days, paid public holidays.
  • Medical insurance.
  • Maternity leave.
  • IT club membership.
  • Employee referral program.
  • Recognition program with gifts and awards.
  • Pet-friendly and eco-friendly.
  • Direct and easy communication with management.
